source_text: I’m not ready yet. I need a nice suit before I dare have dinner with the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I’m not ready yet. I need a nice suit before I dare have dinner with the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I’m not ready yet. I need a nice suit before I dare have dinner with the commissioner."

translation: Jeszcze nie jestem gotowy. Potrzebuję eleganckiego garnituru, zanim odważę się iść na kolację z panią komisarz.

source_text: I’m not ready yet. I should bring some wine and not show up empty handed.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I’m not ready yet. I should bring some wine and not show up empty handed.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I’m not ready yet. I should bring some wine and not show up empty handed."

translation: Jeszcze nie jestem gotowy. Powinienem przynieść wino i nie przychodzić z pustymi rękami.

source_text: I’ve got the wine, and I’ve got a nice suit… I’m ready.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ve got the wine, and I’ve got a nice suit… I’m ready.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ve got the wine, and I’ve got a nice suit… I’m ready."

translation: Mam wino i mam elegancki garnitur… Jestem gotowy.

source_text: 1Hero. Nice of you to come over on such short notice.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp^.1Hero. Nice of you to come over on such short notice.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp^.1Hero. Nice of you to come over on such short notice."

translation: 1Hero. Miło, że wpadłeś tak szybko.

source_text: I’m looking forward to speaking with the two of you.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.I’m looking forward to speaking with the two of you.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.I’m looking forward to speaking with the two of you."

translation: Cieszę się, że mogę porozmawiać z wami obojgiem.

source_text: Thank you for being able to meet at my home.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp^.Thank you for being able to meet at my home.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp^.Thank you for being able to meet at my home."

translation: Dziękuję, że mogliście spotkać się u mnie w domu.

source_text: I’d love our chat to be comfortable.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.I’d love our chat to be comfortable.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.I’d love our chat to be comfortable."

translation: Chciałabym, żeby nasza rozmowa była komfortowa.

source_text: And private.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.And private.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.And private."

translation: I prywatna.

source_text: 1Hero, did you bring the aloe plant?

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp^.1Hero, did you bring the aloe plant?
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp^.1Hero, did you bring the aloe plant?"

translation: 1Hero, przyniosłeś aloes?

source_text: This drink of yours sounds interesting.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.This drink of yours sounds interesting.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.This drink of yours sounds interesting."

translation: Twój trunek brzmi interesująco.

source_text: Something my great-grandfather taught me.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.Something my great-grandfather taught me.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.Something my great-grandfather taught me."

translation: Nauczył mnie tego mój pradziadek.

source_text: An old family recipe? Sounds intriguing.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.An old family recipe? Sounds intriguing.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.An old family recipe? Sounds intriguing."

translation: Stary rodzinny przepis? Brzmi intrygująco.

source_text: Come this way. I’ll show you my home.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.Come this way. I’ll show you my home.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.Come this way. I’ll show you my home."

translation: Chodź tędy. Pokażę ci mój dom.

source_text: Actually, I left it at my home just across the way. I’ll be right back.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Actually, I left it at my home just across the way. I’ll be right back.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Actually, I left it at my home just across the way. I’ll be right back."

translation: Właściwie zostawiłem go w domu tuż obok. Zaraz wracam.

source_text: Don’t be long, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe^.Don’t be long, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe^.Don’t be long, 1Hero."

translation: Nie zwlekaj, 1Hero.

source_text: I forgot to pick up an aloe plant.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I forgot to pick up an aloe plant.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I forgot to pick up an aloe plant."

translation: Zapomniałem wziąć aloesu.

source_text: It’s the damn operation… The mansion belongs to the state…

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.It’s the damn operation… The mansion belongs to the state…
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.It’s the damn operation… The mansion belongs to the state…"

translation: To przez tę operację… Rezydencja należy do stanu…

source_text: We’re giving up?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.We’re giving up?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.We’re giving up?"

translation: Poddajemy się?

source_text: Keep it a secret, Erica… This is far from over.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Keep it a secret, Erica… This is far from over.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Keep it a secret, Erica… This is far from over."

translation: Zachowaj to w tajemnicy, Erica… To jeszcze dalekie od końca.

source_text: I’ll be safe, 1Hero. I need to talk to Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.I’ll be safe, 1Hero. I need to talk to Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.I’ll be safe, 1Hero. I need to talk to Kimberly."

translation: Będę bezpieczna, 1Hero. Muszę porozmawiać z Kimberly.

source_text: Let her know I didn’t mean for this to happen.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Let her know I didn’t mean for this to happen.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Let her know I didn’t mean for this to happen."

translation: Daj jej znać, że nie chciałam, by do tego doszło.

source_text: I will… I understand.

structure.raw_value: ErBaOp.I will… I understand.
structure.script_literal: "ErBaOp.I will… I understand."

translation: Przekażę… Rozumiem.

source_text: Well, I guess that’s one way to handle things…

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.Well, I guess that’s one way to handle things…
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.Well, I guess that’s one way to handle things…"

translation: Cóż, chyba tak można to załatwić…

source_text: I hope Kimberly isn’t too pissed at me.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.I hope Kimberly isn’t too pissed at me.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.I hope Kimberly isn’t too pissed at me."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Kimberly nie jest na mnie zbyt wściekła.

source_text: Don’t fuck this up.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Don’t fuck this up.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.Don’t fuck this up."

translation: Nie spieprz tego.

source_text: You don’t mean that. You’d love to see me fall from grace.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.You don’t mean that. You’d love to see me fall from grace.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.You don’t mean that. You’d love to see me fall from grace."

translation: Nie mówisz serio. Chciałabyś zobaczyć, jak wypadam z łask.

source_text: Not at the expense of my work.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Not at the expense of my work.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.Not at the expense of my work."

translation: Nie kosztem mojej pracy.

source_text: This isn’t really your work anymore.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.This isn’t really your work anymore.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.This isn’t really your work anymore."

translation: To już nie jest twoja praca.

source_text: I’m still a part of this case, 1Hero. And you still work for me.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.I’m still a part of this case, 1Hero. And you still work for me.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.I’m still a part of this case, 1Hero. And you still work for me."

translation: Nadal jestem częścią tej sprawy, 1Hero. I nadal dla mnie pracujesz.

source_text: And I look forward to more… private meetings.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.And I look forward to more… private meetings.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.And I look forward to more… private meetings."

translation: I liczę na kolejne… prywatne spotkania.

source_text: Where the hell is she?

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.Where the hell is she?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.Where the hell is she?"

translation: Gdzie ona, do cholery, jest?

source_text: She’s not answering the door?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.She’s not answering the door?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.She’s not answering the door?"

translation: Nie otwiera drzwi?

source_text: She must be away.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.She must be away.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.She must be away."

translation: Pewnie jej nie ma.

source_text: I’ll see if I can figure out where she is.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll see if I can figure out where she is.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll see if I can figure out where she is."

translation: Spróbuję dowiedzieć się, gdzie jest.

source_text: Jon!?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Jon!?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Jon!?"

translation: Jon!?

source_text: I’m here to meet with the commissioner.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m here to meet with the commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m here to meet with the commissioner."

translation: Przyszedłem spotkać się z panią komisarz.

source_text: Lucky me… This is my client.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.Lucky me… This is my client.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.Lucky me… This is my client."

translation: Szczęściarz ze mnie… To mój klient.

source_text: Huh?...

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Huh?...
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Huh?..."

translation: Słucham?...

source_text: Holy shit! She’s shipping treasures!

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.Holy shit! She’s shipping treasures!
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.Holy shit! She’s shipping treasures!"

translation: O cholera! Ona przemyca skarby!

source_text: How much is she paying you?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How much is she paying you?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How much is she paying you?"

translation: Ile ci płaci?

source_text: Not a dime. After this, my record is clean.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.Not a dime. After this, my record is clean.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.Not a dime. After this, my record is clean."

translation: Ani grosza. Potem moja kartoteka jest czysta.

source_text: You’re here.

structure.raw_value: NeBaOp.You’re here.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaOp.You’re here."

translation: Jesteś tutaj.

source_text: You don’t have to kill Duncan… She’ll never know.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.You don’t have to kill Duncan… She’ll never know.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.You don’t have to kill Duncan… She’ll never know."

translation: Nie musisz zabijać Duncana… Ona nigdy się nie dowie.

source_text: Does it matter if she knows? My fate is tied to hers… What choice do I have?

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Does it matter if she knows? My fate is tied to hers… What choice do I have?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Does it matter if she knows? My fate is tied to hers… What choice do I have?"

translation: Czy to ma znaczenie, czy się dowie? Mój los jest związany z jej… Jaki mam wybór?

source_text: Nellie… Duncan’s not lying…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Nellie… Duncan’s not lying…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Nellie… Duncan’s not lying…"

translation: Nellie… Duncan nie kłamie…

source_text: Shit… You’re his son.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.Shit… You’re his son.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.Shit… You’re his son."

translation: Cholera… Jesteś jego synem.

source_text: I have no idea how… But it’s true.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I have no idea how… But it’s true.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I have no idea how… But it’s true."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia jak… Ale to prawda.

source_text: I thought it was just more of his crazy ramblings.

structure.raw_value: NeSaDe.I thought it was just more of his crazy ramblings.
structure.script_literal: "NeSaDe.I thought it was just more of his crazy ramblings."

translation: Myślałem, że to tylko jego chore brednie.

source_text: Carol and Heather… They knew him when they were much younger.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Carol and Heather… They knew him when they were much younger.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Carol and Heather… They knew him when they were much younger."

translation: Carol i Heather… Znały go, gdy były znacznie młodsze.

source_text: I don’t know what to tell you, 1Hero… But we’re in a pickle.

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.I don’t know what to tell you, 1Hero… But we’re in a pickle.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.I don’t know what to tell you, 1Hero… But we’re in a pickle."

translation: Nie wiem, co ci powiedzieć, 1Hero… Ale mamy problem.

source_text: If you have any ideas, I’m all ears…

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.If you have any ideas, I’m all ears…
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.If you have any ideas, I’m all ears…"

translation: Jeśli masz jakieś pomysły, słucham…

source_text: But you and I both know I lied to Andrea…

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.But you and I both know I lied to Andrea…
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.But you and I both know I lied to Andrea…"

translation: Ale oboje wiemy, że okłamałem Andreę…

source_text: If I wanted to take Duncan down, I could. He trusts me.

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.If I wanted to take Duncan down, I could. He trusts me.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.If I wanted to take Duncan down, I could. He trusts me."

translation: Gdybym chciał dorwać Duncana, mógłbym. Ufa mi.

source_text: Give me some time, Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Give me some time, Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Give me some time, Nellie."

translation: Daj mi trochę czasu, Nellie.

source_text: I’m guessing we don’t have a lot.

structure.raw_value: NeSaDe.I’m guessing we don’t have a lot.
structure.script_literal: "NeSaDe.I’m guessing we don’t have a lot."

translation: Chyba nie mamy go wiele.

source_text: Girl problems?

structure.raw_value: JoBaOp.Girl problems?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaOp.Girl problems?"

translation: Problemy z dziewczynami?

source_text: Not this time…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Not this time…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Not this time…"

translation: Nie tym razem…

source_text: Guild problems.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Guild problems.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Guild problems."

translation: Problemy z Gildią.

source_text: Nope! I don’t want to hear about it.

structure.raw_value: JoWoCl.Nope! I don’t want to hear about it.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoCl.Nope! I don’t want to hear about it."

translation: Nie! Nie chcę o tym słyszeć.

source_text: 1Hero, have you seen the commissioner?

structure.raw_value: OaBaOp.1Hero, have you seen the commissioner?
structure.script_literal: "OaBaOp.1Hero, have you seen the commissioner?"

translation: 1Hero, widziałeś panią komisarz?

source_text: We can’t find her. She’s disappeared.

structure.raw_value: OaBaEx.We can’t find her. She’s disappeared.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaEx.We can’t find her. She’s disappeared."

translation: Nie możemy jej znaleźć. Zniknęła.

source_text: Heather?

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.Heather?
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.Heather?"

translation: Heather?

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: HeShOpNo1.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "HeShOpNo1.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: I was about to ask you the same thing.

structure.raw_value: HeBaOp.I was about to ask you the same thing.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaOp.I was about to ask you the same thing."

translation: Chciałem zapytać cię o to samo.

source_text: I’ve been thinking about upgrading my home, but it can only get so big.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ve been thinking about upgrading my home, but it can only get so big.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ve been thinking about upgrading my home, but it can only get so big."

translation: Zastanawiałem się nad powiększeniem domu, ale da się go powiększyć tylko do pewnego stopnia.

source_text: So I’m considering buying a new home.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.So I’m considering buying a new home.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.So I’m considering buying a new home."

translation: Więc rozważam kupno nowego domu.

source_text: New home? So you were thinking about buying this mansion?

structure.raw_value: HeFlDe.New home? So you were thinking about buying this mansion?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlDe.New home? So you were thinking about buying this mansion?"

translation: Nowy dom? Więc myślałeś o kupnie tej rezydencji?

source_text: I’m sorry, 1Hero, but this place is super expensive. A detective just doesn’t make that kind of money.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.I’m sorry, 1Hero, but this place is super expensive. A detective just doesn’t make that kind of money.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.I’m sorry, 1Hero, but this place is super expensive. A detective just doesn’t make that kind of money."

translation: Przepraszam, 1Hero, ale to miejsce jest super drogie. Detektyw po prostu nie zarabia takich pieniędzy.

source_text: You might be surprised.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.You might be surprised.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.You might be surprised."

translation: Możesz się zdziwić.

source_text: Unless you have a lot of money, I won’t be.

structure.raw_value: HeBaDe.Unless you have a lot of money, I won’t be.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaDe.Unless you have a lot of money, I won’t be."

translation: Chyba że masz dużo pieniędzy, nie zdziwię się.

source_text: I’m good at investing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’m good at investing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’m good at investing."

translation: Jestem dobry w inwestowaniu.

source_text: Oh really? Wouldn’t have anything to do with your side hustle with Jon?

structure.raw_value: HeFlOp.Oh really? Wouldn’t have anything to do with your side hustle with Jon?
structure.script_literal: "HeFlOp.Oh really? Wouldn’t have anything to do with your side hustle with Jon?"

translation: Och, naprawdę? To nie ma nic wspólnego z twoją fuchą u Jona?

source_text: Might be a part of it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Might be a part of it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Might be a part of it."

translation: Może częściowo.

source_text: Well, if you’re really interested, I could sell it to you.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Well, if you’re really interested, I could sell it to you.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Well, if you’re really interested, I could sell it to you."

translation: Cóż, jeśli naprawdę jesteś zainteresowany, mogę ci ją sprzedać.

source_text: You’re the realtor?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.You’re the realtor?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.You’re the realtor?"

translation: Ty jesteś agentką nieruchomości?

source_text: Yours truly.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEd.Yours truly.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEd.Yours truly."

translation: We własnej osobie.

source_text: How did that happen?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How did that happen?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How did that happen?"

translation: Jak do tego doszło?

source_text: I wasn’t supposed to be, but I got a phone call from the state.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.I wasn’t supposed to be, but I got a phone call from the state.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.I wasn’t supposed to be, but I got a phone call from the state."

translation: Nie miałam nią być, ale dostałam telefon ze stanu.

source_text: They asked me to handle it after they decided a public auction wouldn’t bring in the funds they wanted.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.They asked me to handle it after they decided a public auction wouldn’t bring in the funds they wanted.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.They asked me to handle it after they decided a public auction wouldn’t bring in the funds they wanted."

translation: Poprosili mnie, żebym się tym zajęła, po tym jak uznali, że publiczna aukcja nie przyniesie takich funduszy, jakich chcą.

source_text: Alright, so how do we do this? You helped me the last time through everything.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Alright, so how do we do this? You helped me the last time through everything.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Alright, so how do we do this? You helped me the last time through everything."

translation: Dobra, więc jak to zrobimy? Ostatnim razem przeprowadziłaś mnie przez wszystko.

source_text: As long as you have the money, I can get the paperwork together. We just have to get the judge to sign off on it.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.As long as you have the money, I can get the paperwork together. We just have to get the judge to sign off on it.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.As long as you have the money, I can get the paperwork together. We just have to get the judge to sign off on it."

translation: Dopóki masz pieniądze, mogę przygotować papiery. Musimy tylko zdobyć podpis sędziego.

source_text: I have the money, but where is the realtor?

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.I have the money, but where is the realtor?
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.I have the money, but where is the realtor?"

translation: Mam pieniądze, ale gdzie jest agentka nieruchomości?
